articleTitle: Research on Text Information Mining Technology of Substation Inspection Based on Improved Jieba
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, the power system has accumulated a lot of data. The inspection records of substations are mostly manual records. These data are recorded and stored in the power database in the form of text, which is difficult to use. Aiming at the problem that general word segmentation technologies have poor performance in power text recognition, this paper proposes to use TF-IDF algorithm to improve general Jieba word segmentation technology. The TF-IDF algorithm is used to identify and weight the power feature words, and update the data with higher weights to the keyword list, and more important words are retained. This article realizes the effective word segmentation of the text of the substation inspection record. Through comparative experiments with traditional techniques, segmentation technology that improves the accuracy and professionalism.

articleTitle: Comparison and Simulation Study of the Sparse Representation Matching Pursuit Algorithm and the Orthogonal Matching Pursuit Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, sparse representation technology has made outstanding contributions in signal processing, image processing, target recognition, blind source separation, etc. Greedy algorithms are an important class of algorithms in the field of sparse representation, and matching pursuit algorithm and orthogonal matching pursuit algorithm are two typical greedy algorithms. The orthogonal matching pursuit algorithm has a great improvement in the convergence time compared with the matching pursuit algorithm, but the matching pursuit algorithm is still used in many current scenarios where greedy algorithm is applied. In order to understand the signal reconstruction effect of greedy algorithms and to analyze and compare the advantages and disadvantages of different algorithms, this paper briefly analyzes and compares these two typical greedy algorithms from the principle to simulation, and obtains the simulation results of matching pursuit algorithm and orthogonal matching pursuit algorithm and compares the advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: A comprehensive study of 5G and 6G networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: 5G has been widely deployed, and more key technologies of 5G are in the process of being standardized. It plays an important role in promoting the aspects of the internet of vehicles, smart homes, etc. However, due to its limitations, 5G technology cannot meet the technical requirements of augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), smart industry, intelligent traffic system (ITS), and other new application scenarios in the 2030s. A large number of technology researches and standard studies about 6G have also been proposed. The potential technologies of 6G, such as reflecting surface (IRS) and Terahertz (THz), are proposed to solve the current constraints of 5G. This comprehensive study will explain the evolution process of wireless communication networks from the first to the sixth generation and compare the key performance indicators between 4G, 5Gand 6G. Moreover, we will introduce some main application scenarios of 5G and 6G and some key technologies of 5G and 6G.

articleTitle: Research on the Pulse-position Modulation in the Digital Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of digital communication, pulse-position modulation (PPM) has become an important technique in wireless communication because of its efficient bandwidth utilization and sensitive detection efficiency. Many scholars have conducted in-depth research on it. In this paper, we design a model of a PPM system that requires 3 bits to transmit each signal, and the system includes a modulator and demodulator. Then, we use MATLAB to simulate the pulse-position modulation signal transmission in an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN). We calculate the bit error rate (BER) by generating many random signals under different signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). We finally verify the characteristics of PPM by comparing it with after modulation methods. This paper aims to analyze the characteristics of PPM in wireless communications through the simulation of a PPM method. Then we draw the conclusions that PPM has a low noise interference and a strong anti-interference ability. Hence, we present the outlooks for the development of pulse-position modulation in the future.

articleTitle: The Role of Massive MIMO and Intelligent Reflecting Surface in 5G/6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The fifth generation (5G) mobile communication systems are being widely deployed and tested worldwide, and the key techniques are gradually maturing in 2021. Considering the general needs in the future of the explosive growth of data, researchers around the world are beginning to study the next-generation system, i.e., the sixth generation (6G) communication systems, which will be deployed in the future network of 2030. This review begins with the historical development of communication systems, and elaborates on the current and future innovations of communication technologies. The key technology of 5G, massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO), is introduced, especially into the advantages and challenges to the deployment of 5G. Meanwhile, the potential key technology in 6G, intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) is also presented, the concept of IRS and the advantage in the aspect of energy efficiency is given in the paper.

articleTitle: QoS Flow Mapping Method of Multi-service 5G Communication for Urban Energy Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: 5G is rapidly becoming a pivotal technology to support power systems with the advantages of high bandwidth and low latency. However, due to the rapid growth of data traffic in power services, the 5G communication system would be unable to cope with the growing traffic demand and still faces some application challenges for the specific QoS requirements of different service streams. Based on 3GPP TS23.501 wireless communication network architecture and IEC TR 61850-90-12 power automation system communication protocol, this paper applies the power service flow port and QoS delay indicators as the basis for discrimination, and provides the B5G QoS mapping method of the power service flow based on IP DSCP for the first time with a goal of solving the communication challenges of power mass data transmission and multiple types of services.

articleTitle: Real identity based access control technology under zero trust architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the rapid development and application of emerging information technology, the traditional network security architecture is more and more difficult to support flexible dynamic and a wider range of business data access requirements. Zero trust technology can truly realize the aggregation of security and business by building an end-to-end dynamic new boundary based on identity, which puts forward a new direction for the upgrade and evolution of enterprise network security architecture. This paper mainly includes access control and identity authentication management functions. The goal of access control system is to ensure that legitimate and secure users can use the system normally, and then protect the security of enterprise network and server. The functions of the access control system include identifying the user’s identity (legitimacy), evaluating the security characteristics (Security) of the user’s machine, and taking corresponding response strategies.

articleTitle: Research on clustering algorithm of user electricity behavior for identification of typical should scene
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the construction of smart grid, advanced power equipment based on multiple types is increasing. More and more power data can be obtained by sensing devices and sent to edge devices and cloud computing servers through communication networks, supporting a variety of advanced applications. Among them, there are a lot of data-driven ARTIFICIAL intelligence computing analysis, are based on the power big data for computing analysis. However, for massive power big data, it is impossible to obtain more internal relevant information only by observing the data from the surface. To a certain extent, it directly affects the upper level of advanced applications. To solve this problem, this paper studies a clustering algorithm of electricity consumption behavior for typical scene identification based on DBSCAN density clustering algorithm. By clustering user load curve of DBSCAN, the classification of electricity behaviors is realized. AND cluster dispersion (CDI) and the ratio of sum of squares within clusters to differences between clusters (WCBCR) are selected as the indexes to evaluate the clustering quality. In addition, measurement noise can also be identified. The accuracy of the proposed clustering method is verified by experiments on actual user load data.

articleTitle: Real-time fault monitoring method of charging pile based on improved RNN neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The workload of daily operation, maintenance and testing of charging facilities is huge, and the on-site testing management mode is still dominated by manual recording of testing data, lacking intelligent detection and fault analysis means. In this paper, the characteristics of AC and DC charging pile faults are analyzed, and a real-time monitoring method of charging pile faults based on an improved RNN neural network is proposed. A lot of state parameters are associated with the failure of the charging pile. Firstly, the fault detection process is proposed according to the relationship between the characteristics of charging pile state parameters and the fault conditions. Then the model between the fault condition and state parameters of the charging pile is established. Finally, through the new energy vehicle charging pile fault detection data set published by Baidu, it is verified that the method proposed in this paper has high accuracy and feasibility. The method proposed in this paper can make use of the real-time state parameters measured by the measuring equipment of the charging pile itself to judge its fault conditions, and provide support for the next maintenance work and troubleshooting work of the charging pile.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of OPC UA Server Based on SECS/GEM Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of incompatibility of communication data between semiconductor manufacturing industry and other automation industries, a design scheme of OPC UA server development based on SEMI Equipment Communications Standard/Generic Model for Communications (SECS/GEM) was proposed. The design idea and workflow of the whole system are described in detail. After testing, the server has completed real-time communication with the third-party SECS/GEM equipment simulation software and UA client, and solved the problem that the data message in the communication process of semiconductor equipment is not compatible with OPC UA specification.

articleTitle: Design of high voltage live operation robot system
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: To meet domestic live line charged 10 kv distribution network operation requirements, high-voltage live working robot system was developed, including robot subsystem and homework personnel platform subsystem is made up of two parts including, can maximum limit satisfy charged assignments require the use of series parallel manipulator and six dimensional force/torque sensor built teleoperation robot system hardware, and based on it ROS(Robot Operating System) designed the master-slave teleoperation system software to realize the position, pose and force information interaction between the master and slave arms; By mapping the end position and attitude of the main arm to the wrist position and end attitude of the slave arm, the pose mapping model between the master and slave arms is established. Prototype test results show that the designed master-slave teleoperation system can effectively achieve the main arm to from arm position mapping, and by the contact force feedback from the arm to the arm The robot system has been done on the actual live line charged lire welding operation, greatly reduce the labor intensity of the workers and guarantee the safety of operating personnel, meet the requirements of the current live working.

articleTitle: Control and Application of High Voltage Electric Working Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of economic and science and technology, the whole society has increasingly high requirements for reliable and stable operation of the power system. As a key part of the power system, distribution network maintenance and new access to the network need different degrees of planning or temporary power outage to complete With the progress of technology. It is of great significance to improve the stability of power supply if the maintenance without power failure or new operation can be realized in the distribution network link. In this paper, the development status and characteristics of live work robot technology for distribution lines are reviewed. The problems existing in the design and application of live work robot are analyzed.

articleTitle: The Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm Based-on Particle Energy and Particle Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (AOA) is a new-proposed meta-heuristic algorithm motivated by the distribution behavior of the leading arithmetic operators. It is proved to perform well in optimization processes of complex engineering design problems. AOA has a slow convergence rate and tends to fall into local minima in multimodal optimization problems. This paper proposes an Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm based on particle energy and particle diffusion. On the one hand, the introduction of particle energy increases the chance of updating the particle’s position, which has not gained a satisfying solution, accelerating the convergence rate. On the other hand, particle diffusion prevents particles trapping in local minima. To verify the efficiency of the proposed algorithm, Improved Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (IAOA) is compared with nine state-of-the-art algorithms on 23 benchmark functions. Numerical results and Wilcoxon’s rank-sum tests show that IAOA performs significantly better than the original AOA and other comparative algorithms in convergence rate and solution accuracy.

articleTitle: Insulator Fault Recognizing via Modified Faster R-CNN Using UAV Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Insulator fault recognition is a common hidden danger that affects the normal operation of the power system. In recent years, UAV aerial images have been widely used to identify defects in insulators. In order to solve the problem of low efficiency caused by manual inspection and traditional image defect detection methods, this paper proposed a modified Faster R-CNN model to improve the accuracy of model detection and reduce the amount of model parameters. Based on the traditional Faster R-CNN detection framework, the proposed method selected ResNet- 50 to replace VGGNet-16 as the feature extraction networks. The database used 781 labeled UAV aerial insulator images, and they are divided into training set, validation set and test set according to the ratio of 6:2:2. The mAP of the modified feature network model reached 62.41%, and the network model parameter size was 25.26M. Compared with the original framework with VGGNet-16 as the feature network, the mAP increased by 3.43% and the parameter amount was compressed by 4.41 times. The results show that the improved algorithm reduces the missed detection rate and false detection rate, and on the basis of improving the recognition accuracy, it can greatly reduce the amount of network parameters. And it can better meet the needs of lightweight network structure in actual scenarios.

articleTitle: Study on key technique and research hotspot of low orbit satellite communication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Low earth orbit (LEO) satellite communication, as an important part of current satellite communication networks, has attracted intensive research interest in the communication sphere due to its specific advantages such as short transmission delay, small losses and good inter-satellite link quality. At present, LEO constellations have been widely applied in the communication services. Based on two pillars, namely, the key techniques and correlated hotspot issues, this paper targeted the typical researches as well as the latest progresses. We focused on the development of cellular networks and multi-beam technique concerning LEO satellite communication. After discussing existing handover schemes and challenges, we proposed some future directions.

articleTitle: Power log partition collection and storage system based on alliance blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The power system log is used to record the operating data of power equipment, and it has a pivotal position in the management of power equipment. Green development is an inevitable requirement for building a modern economic system and an important part of the high-quality development of power companies. Aiming at the problems of the authenticity, validity, and security of the information in the power system, as well as the requirements of decarbonization and emission reduction, a power system log partition collection and storage system based on alliance blockchain technology is proposed. The system uses blockchain technology's distributed storage, decentralization, data resistance to tampering, consensus authentication, and traceability characteristics to store power system data, avoiding artificial attacks and tampering of information, and ensuring the authenticity of information, Traceability and safety, provide effective guarantee for later use.

articleTitle: Weather Classification Based On Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Identification and forecast of weather conditions are important for transportation safety, environment, meteorology. Under the background of Artificial intelligence, the methods of weather conditions recognition based on deep learning can solve the problems of traditional weather conditions recognition. In addition, it can also realize the real-time judgment of weather recognition. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is an important network structure in deep learning. By introducing convolution layer, pooling layer, and deeper network structure, CNN perceives higher semantic features and enhances the image classification effect. In view of the weather conditions of visual images (sunny, foggy, rainy, snowy) which are difficult to be identified by the traditional weather recognition methods. In this paper, we proposed a weather recognition framework based on the convolution neural network architecture whose accuracy is improved by 5.06% compared with traditional methods.

articleTitle: Interference Cancellation Performance of a Three-Channel Adaptive Co-site Interference Cancellation System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper investigates the convergence characteristic of a three-channel adaptive interference cancellation system (AICS-3ch) and the influence of some on-ideal factors on AICS-3ch. The convergence course was analyzed by solving weight equations. The calculation method of interference cancellation ratio was analyzed and deduced under the influence of different gain and zero shift on AICS-3ch. The design criterion with different gain and the effective suppression method of zero shift were studied and proposed. Finally, the validity and effectiveness of the analysis results and the proposed method are confirmed by simulation experiment.

articleTitle: A multi-target tracking algorithm suitable for road scenes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Traditionally, multiple target tracking and target detection are carried out using separate models, which leads to non-sharing of features and inability to track in real time. Now with the rapid development of target detection and re-identification (re-ID) technology, this paper proposes a conceptually simple and effective joint detection and tracking model. Its detection module and tracking module are isomorphic networks, which are based on anchor- The CenterNet network of the free mechanism is used as the backbone network, and all the convolutional layers in the up sampling are replaced with deformable convolutions, so as to adapt to the geometric deformation of different tracking targets. Second, the tracking module calculates the re-ID feature for each pixel, outputs the calculated similarity between the detection frame and the trajectory frame, uses the Hungarian algorithm and the correlation metric of the measurable bounding box overlap, and uses the Kalman algorithm to perform data association frame by frame. The trajectory filling strategy is used to balance the number of missed and false positives. Finally, experiments are carried out on the open target tracking data set, which proves the superiority and effectiveness of the proposed model, and realizes the tracking of pedestrians, vehicles, bicycles and tricycles in four target categories.

articleTitle: Unpaired Low-Dose CT Denoising using Conditional GAN with Structural Loss
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Low-dose CT has been a popular diagnostic imaging for its high availability and less radiation than normal-dose CT. Reducing the noise and reconstructing a noise-free CT image is a hotspot for researchers. The existing methods cannot deal with unpaired data well yet while the paired data is difficult to obtain. With unpaired data, we proposed an effective method using conditional generative adversarial network with Structural Loss to solve this problem. Our method is simpler and more efficient on computation than other unpaired methods and our experiments showed that it is comparable to other deep learning methods on denoising performance.

articleTitle: Overview of the Relationship between Mechatronic Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The improvement of the development level of mechatronics engineering in the new era has played an important role in promoting the improvement of social production conditions and the increase of productivity. In this context, it is necessary to pay attention to the application of intelligent control engineering and artificial intelligence in order to increase the technical content of mechatronics engineering and improve the level of intelligence in this type of engineering practice. Focusing on the development of mechatronic engineering on AI trend and provide effective technical support for sustainable development can help the production lines to meet the diverse needs of related production practices. In view of this, the article systematically elaborates based on the application of intelligent control engineering and artificial intelligence in mechatronic engineering and gives several real examples of practice applications. It can be a reference for related researchers.

articleTitle: Chua's design based on hysteresis comparator and its application to image encryption
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to improve the chaotic dynamics behavior of Chua’s circuit, simplify the circuit design, using hysteresis comparator to design a new class of Chua’s circuit, according to the equation of each state variable corresponding relation connect each module circuit for its physical circuit, theoretical analysis and simulation results are consistent, which prove the accuracy of circuit and the design is effective. chaotic sequence to encrypt image, the encryption histogram, results show that the new systems are very sensitive to image key and plaintext, key space is large, chaotic system applied to image encryption has higher safety performance.

articleTitle: Software Defined Network based 5G and Time- Sensitive Network Fusion For Power services with Ultra-low Latency Requirements
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The power system has some services that are sensitive to packet loss and delay, such as distribution automation, distribution network differential protection, and intelligent distribution. Even a small increase in response time will affect service performance. With the development and construction of 5G network system technology, the network demand of vertical industries is upgraded to high-performance indicators such as ultra-reliable and low latency communications, and certainty. The integrated deployment of time-sensitive network technology and 5G network system has become a research hotspot. With the help of time-sensitive network (TSN) technology, 5G network can provide defined transmission guarantee capability for power service and meet the ultra-low delay requirements of power service. This paper aims to use software defined network (SDN) to achieve the integration of 5G and TSN, so as to better meet the security, reliability, flexibility requirements of power service, improve differentiated service guarantee ability, and greatly improve the independent and controllable ability of power enterprises for their own service.

articleTitle: RiceNet: a lightweight instance segmentation network for adhesive rice grains
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Crop appearance quality detection based on machine vision has attracted more and more attention in recent years. On the sampling inspection table, because rice grains may touch and adhere to each other, if the collected images are not segmented and preprocessed, it will cause errors in the subsequent evaluation of rice appearance quality. In this paper, an improved adhesive rice grains segmentation network named RiceNet based on Mask R-CNN is proposed. RiceNet uses VoVNetV2 as the backbone network to extract image features. Considering that the research object is the adhesive rice grains image, the target category is single and it is relatively easy to detect, the number of convolution layers and channels of VoVNetV2 are adjusted to carry out the lightweight design of the network. Compared with Mask R-CNN, the accuracy rate and recall rate of RiceNet have increased from 87.2% and 89.7% to 89.5% and 92.6% respectively. Furthermore, RiceNet has few structural parameters which is very suitable for integration into embedded and mobile detection equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Environment of Civil Aviation Station
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In this paper, by studying the theories related to the electromagnetic environment of aviation stations (electromagnetic compatibility, radio waves, ground navigation equipment), the electromagnetic compatibility test and function, electromagnetic interference are analyzed, and the specific algorithm flow is obtained. Finally, the aviation station The management of the electromagnetic environment puts forward relevant suggestions, which have certain reference value for the reasonable and scientific planning of spectrum resources and the elimination of hidden dangers of radio interference.

articleTitle: Status quo and trends of key technologies for integrated energy services
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Since the launch of China’s new round of power sector reforms in March 2015, the integrated energy service business is becoming the second largest business of power grid companies besides the power transmission and distribution business. Integrated energy services business involves the production, transmission, use, storage, and management of multiple energy sources such as electricity, heat, cooling, and gas, with a wide variety of related technologies. This paper analyzes the status quo and trend of key technologies for each of the six categories of integrated energy services defined by the State Grid Corporation of China. It not only makes up for the lack of systematic analysis of the key technologies of integrated energy services in the existing literature, but also provides references for relevant enterprises their practicies of integrated energy services.

articleTitle: A novel collaborative jamming method based on decoy strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As a tool for real-time online interaction with the environment, reinforcement learning is widely used in communication confrontation. We proposed a novel cooperative jamming method based on decoy strategy to fight the anti-jamming user based on Q-Learning algorithm. With the same power consumption, the proposed strategy is greatly improved compared with traditional jamming methods such as frequency scanning jamming and fixed-band jamming. Simulation results show that the strategy prevents the intelligent users from learning the complete jamming policy, i. e., its strategy cannot converge. With the jamming mode switched every 400 steps, compared with traditional jamming, the average jamming accuracy increases 36.9%, the user average throughput reducing 53.7%.

articleTitle: Dynamic measurement error detection method of high voltage current transformer based on reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The current measurement error detection method of transformer is to get the measurement error by comparing the measured value with the standard value under the condition of the same standard source. The detection process is cumbersome, and it needs repeated detection for many times to ensure the detection accuracy. In order to improve the measurement accuracy of current transformer, aiming at the limitations of current error detection methods, a dynamic measurement method of high voltage current transformer measurement error based on reinforcement learning is studied. Based on the analysis of measurement error of high voltage current transformer, the transfer coefficient is calculated. Taking the transfer coefficient as the feature, the power value of power grid is predicted by reinforcement learning, and the measurement error is obtained by comparing the measured value of transformer with the predicted value. Through the comparative experiment, it is verified that the designed dynamic detection method of transformer metering error has higher detection accuracy, response speed is improved by about 17.1%, and the performance is better.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies Of UAV Navigation and Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) visual navigation technology is one of the current research hotpots in the field of computer vision. Its purpose is to use the visual information of aerial images to achieve continuous, stable and accurate positioning of UAV. With the continuous upgrading of hardware platforms, UAV are widely used in many fields such as national defense, military, disaster detection, and geological exploration. Most UAVs rely on the equipped Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) for navigation and positioning. However, radios that acquire the system are prone to signal loss or deliberate attacks. UAV are expensive, and positioning systems play a vital role in their stability and safety during flight. Vision-based navigation and positioning technology does not rely on satellite positioning systems, and is of great significance for unmanned aerial vehicles to achieve autonomous flight tasks when CNSS signals are lost. This article analyzes and designs the UAV visual positioning system in outdoor environment, conducts in-depth research on visual information extraction and positioning estimation, and proposes a series of improvement measures.

articleTitle: A Research on Internet of Things with CRC Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As one of the most valuable technical supports of the Internet of Things (IoT), Bluetooth Low Energy is a research hot spot to promote IoT development. This paper introduces Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and its modulation and Cyclic Redundancy Check(CRC) and summarizes the advantages of Low Power Bluetooth and CRC. Firstly, the definition of low- power Bluetooth is described in the introduction, and the advantages of low-power Bluetooth are listed by comparing BLE with traditional Bluetooth. Secondly, we introduce the CRC method in detail, deduce the principle of CRC Coding, and conclude that the CRC code can directly improve the packet receiving rate of the receiving end and reduce the energy consumption of the sending end in the process of transmission due to the introduction of redundancy code. Finally, we introduce the CRC method in detail, deduce the principle of CRC Coding, and conclude that the CRC code can directly improve the packet receiving rate of the receiving end and reduce the energy consumption of the sending end in the process of transmission due to the introduction of redundancy code. Based on Bluetooth Low Energy on the current as an important part of the Internet, this paper studies its outstanding advantages, modulation coding, and CRC. It makes a detailed description and derivation of these three aspects. A series of important conclusions are drawn, which enable readers to quickly understand Bluetooth and IoT.

articleTitle: Charging Scheduling Strategies of Cooperated Car-hailing Operating Business for Electric Taxis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the popularity of electric vehicles (EVs), the replacement on the traditional fuel taxis to the electric taxis (e-taxis) has been gradually emerged in a creasing number of cities. Compared with the ordinary EVs, e-taxis require frequent charging due to their long daily mileage and high total power consumption. Additionally, the disorderly charging behaviors of EVs have caused congestion in charging stations (CSs) and have seriously affected the normal business of e-taxi drivers. This paper proposes a management architecture that combines the charging network and the car-hailing operating network of e-taxis. With the goal of minimizing the charging cost of e-taxis, a set of scheduling strategy which combines car-hailing operating business and charging plan is designed based on reinforcement learning (RL). The result shows that this strategy can effectively lower the charging cost of e-taxis by reducing the charging queue time in the CSs.

articleTitle: A Novel Fast and Dynamic Support for Power Grid Control Strategy of CHB-BESS
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the continuous development of power electronics technology and the large-scale access of new energy power generation, the stable operation of the power grid is facing huge challenges. Medium voltage cascaded energy storage system with its high power, high conversion efficiency and high capacity utilization has received more and more attention. Firstly, the mathematical model of cascade energy storage system is constructed and its basic operation mechanism is analyzed. Secondly, on the basis of its mathematical model, a new type of fast active support grid control technology is studied, and its control gain and other key control parameters are adjusted online based on the system boundary conditions to achieve fast dynamic response. Finally, the simulation results show that the proposed control strategy is correct and realizable.

Author Keywords: control strategy of fast dynamic support power grid

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Parallel Operation of Converters Based on Adaptive Virtual Inductance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control method can realize parallel operation without communication interconnection between multiple energy storage converters, effectively improving the overall load capacity of the system. However, due to the parameters of the device itself and the access line, the output impedance between the VSGs is different, which easily causes circulating currents between the devices, and power distribution cannot be performed according to the set curve. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an adaptive virtual inductance parallel control algorithm. The algorithm can adjust the virtual inductance value according to the reactive power output by the current converter, the given value of reactive power, the given value of virtual inductance and the virtual inductance adjustment coefficient, so as to realize the adaptive compensation of line impedance between devices and reduce circulating currents. The proposed control method was verified by MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Circularly Polarized Stacked Microstrip Antenna for BeiDou Navigation Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: A single-feed dual-band circularly polarized (CP) stacked microstrip patch antenna is proposed for BeiDou system (BDS) application. The antenna is composed of a double-layer structure, and two layers are fed at the same time through a single feed probe to realize two operating frequency bands. The CP radiation is generated by loading a symmetrical L-shaped truncated corner and a fan-shaped notch in the bottom patch; triangle corners are introduced in the diagonal direction of the upper patch to generate CP radiation. Meanwhile, different slots are loaded on the upper patch and the bottom patch respectively to realize miniaturization. The antenna works in the 1.17645/1.57542 GHz band with a size of 4.6 mm × 80 mm × 80 mm $\left( {0.31{\lambda _0} \times 0.31{\lambda _0} \times 0.018{\lambda _0}} \right).{\text{ When }}|S11| < - 10dB$, the return loss bandwidth is 4.1% for the low-frequency band and 5.0% for the high-frequency band. The simulated 3-dB axial ratio bandwidths are 1.0% and 1.12%, respectively. The simulation results meet the BeiDou system requirements for microstrip antenna performance.

articleTitle: Low Illumination Image Enhancement Algorithm Combining Homomorphic Filtering and Retinex
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of blurred details and dim colors in images under low illumination conditions, a low illumination image enhancement algorithm combining homomorphic filtering and Retinex is proposed in this paper. Firstly, in the RGB space of the original image, the homomorphic filtering algorithm based on wavelet transform and improved Butterworth filter is used to processes the image to obtain a detail-enhanced image; Secondly, in the HSV space of the original image, the Retinex algorithm based on the improved bilateral filter function is used to processes the V channel to obtains a color-enhanced image; Finally, the detail-enhanced image and the color-enhanced image are weighted and merged. Comparative experimental data shows that the improved algorithm can effectively enhance the details and colors of the image.

articleTitle: Study on comprehensive benefit evaluation method of battery storage to improve new energy consumption
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Under the dual-carbon goal, new energy is developing rapidly. Due to insufficient flexibility and adjustment of resources, the issue of consumption has become a serious constraint affecting the development of new energy. Battery energy storage technology is an advanced flexible resource, and its use to improve the economics of new energy consumption has always been a research hotspot. This paper analyzes the cost of battery energy storage and the various synergistic benefits of improving new energy consumption, establishes a comprehensive benefit model, and uses specific data as an example to evaluate the comprehensive benefits of battery energy storage to improve new energy consumption.

articleTitle: A New Feeder Automation Scheme Implementing Single-Line-to-Ground Fault Location with Novel Smart Fault Indicators for China's Electric Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper introduced a new feeder automation (FA) scheme implementing single-line-to-ground (SLG) fault location with novel smart fault indicators (SFIs) for China’s electric distribution networks (EDNs). When the novel SFI detected a reverse SLG fault, it will send a sequence of event (SOE) via 4G to the distribution automation system (DAS) master station. The DAS master station locates the SLG fault section based on the SOEs from the SFIs. This FA scheme is tested hy the artificial SLG faults in the Joint Laboratory for Intelligent Application and Key Equipment of Distribution Network of State Grid Corporation of China by the Electric Power Research Institute of State Grid Henan Electric Power Company.

articleTitle: Design of low phase shift attenuator applied to analog self-interference cancellation circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: A voltage variable attenuator applied to 5G all full-duplex communication system is proposed. There will be the self-interference signal that comes from the mismatch of the front-end antenna in the system. The self-interference signal leaked after the signal passing through the circulator, the problem is to eliminate the self-interference signal in the circuit, and the attenuator plays a very important role in it.We compares the designed attenuator with the traditional reflective attenuator, the simulation result can be within the attenuation range of 4.5~42.5dB, the change range of the output phase can be variable within 90°.The measured reach the adjustable range of 4~38dB attenuation and the phase of fluctuation within 95°. The attenuator reduces the influence of the circuit phase.

articleTitle: Simulation study of semiconductor communication protocol SECS/GEM
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: After a series of events that semiconductor industry was threatened, the domestic attention on the semiconductor industry unprecedentedly rises. Currently, back-end automation in semiconductor manufacturing is still low due to inconsistent communication interfaces between devices. The paper focus on a simulation of a semiconductor communication protocol named SECS/GEM (SEMI Equipment Communications Standard/ Generic Model for Communications) to do help to the understanding and implementation of SECS/GEM. The simulation of the protocol was divided into 4 modules: Visualization module, SECS-II module, HSMS module and GEM module, and supplemented by Python language

articleTitle: Research on GIM-based 3D Digital Construction Management Scheme for Power Grid Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: At present, the State Grid Corporation of China attaches great importance to the construction of smart grid, and has basically achieved a high degree of integration, integrating power flow, information flow and business flow effectively. This paper studies the three-dimensional digital construction management scheme of power grid engineering based on the Grid Information Model (GIM) technology, combs the main architecture of the scheme, and provides reference for the digital transformation of enterprises.

articleTitle: An Automatic Generation Method for Distribution Network Geographical Wiring Diagram
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of power transmission and distribution technology, China’s power grid has gradually evolved from the traditional "tree" structure from generation to use to a large modern power grid structure in which power, communication and automation control are integrated, and the power flow and information flow interact. The increasingly complex network intensive structure makes the drawing of single line diagram more difficult. The traditional single line diagram is usually drawn by drafters according to the topological relationship of power system with the help of some common tools such as CAD, which is suitable for simple tree structure without combing smart structure. However, the manual drawing of single line diagram is very heavy, slow and needs to be changed repeatedly to ensure the readability of the graph. The manual drawing cycle is longer, which can not meet the maintenance and management needs of the power grid itself. In this paper, St number algorithm is used to determine the planarity of the original drawing, realize orthogonal mapping, and flatten the complex electrical wiring information. Finally, the IEEE118 bus is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Considering allowable deviation and wind speed distribution wind power business day-ahead market strategy bidding
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of large-scale wind power integration and electricity markets, wind farms business were asked to participate in the electricity market. Because of the volatility and unpredictability of wind power, the wind farm suppliers contribute to obtain benefits in the bidding at the same time, need to bear the imbalances cost of inaccurately reporting output resulting. This paper follows the objective laws of wind power itself, proposes charging the unbalanced cost that needs to consider the power tolerance when the wind speed of the wind farm satisfies the Weibull distribution, and derives the day-ahead market bidding model in detail for the wind farm business. The model aims to maximize the expected benefits of the wind farm business. The wind farm business in the day-ahead market obtains the revenue from the bidding output, and the unbalanced cost charged by the wind farm business exceeds the allowable deviation of the unbalanced market power. The example detailed analysis of the different wind speed distribution parameters and tolerances ratio on the wind farm business’s effect of day-ahead market bidding output.

articleTitle: Improvement of EAP-TLS Protocol based on Pseudonym Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of mobile communication technology, we have now entered the 5G era. While 5G brings us more diversified services, it also brings greater challenges to our privacy protection. Aiming at the problem of identity information leakage caused by the use of the 5G secondary authentication protocol EAP-TLS in an insecure network environment, this paper introduces a pseudonym mechanism and proposes a solution based on user grouping. Users are grouped in advance and assigned corresponding group ID. In the identity authentication phase, the group ID and identity authentication code are used to replace the unique identity of the user and sent to the authentication server. The authentication server determines the user’s group based on the group ID, and uses the identity authentication code to preliminarily determine the user’s identity, so as to achieve the purpose of protecting the privacy of the user’s identity. Finally, the authentication protocol is designed on the existing 5G mobile communication architecture, and the security analysis proves that the protocol can guarantee the security and anonymity of user identity privacy.

articleTitle: Reed-Solomon Coded Cooperative Space-time Block Coded Spatial Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: A novel Reed-Solomon coded cooperative space-time block coded spatial modulation (RSCC-STBC-SM) scheme with two different RS codes is proposed. One RS code with smaller minimum distance is used at the source, but the other one with larger minimum distance is utilized at the relay. To effectively decode the source and relay RS codes, we propose the joint RS decoding algorithm at the destination. Simulation results show that the proposed RSCC-STBC-SM scheme outperforms the direct RS coded STBC-SM (RSC-STBC-SM) scheme. Moreover, our proposed RSCC-STBC-SM scheme also outperforms multiple existing schemes.

articleTitle: Extraction of impervious surface from high-resolution remote sensing image based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The traditional impervious surface extraction algorithm is difficult to keep balance on accuracy and efficiency. Aim to solve this problem, We propose a semantic segmentation model based on deep learning (called Dense-SegUNet). Our contributions are as follows: (1)The efficient encoding and decoding structure of UNet is introduced as the skeleton of Dense-SegUNet to realize semantic segmentation. (2)The advantages of DenseNet are refined, and four Denseblock with different depths and three Transition layer are used as encoding parts for feature extraction. This structure can realize feature reuse, strengthen the transmission of deep information and avoid gradient disappearance. (3)The hard version of swish (h-swish) activation function and test-time enhancement algorithm (TTA) are introduced to improve the accuracy of network model. We compared Dense-SegUNet with traditional classification models and other deep learning models. The results show that the Kappa coefficient of the new model is 15.2% higher than the RF model (0.9530vs0.8272), and 2.7% higher than U-Net (0.9530vs0.9278).

articleTitle: Protection Method of High-Speed Optical Interface Module Against Single Event Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: There are many complex high energy particles in the space environment, which can cause single particle effect in the high-speed optical interface module used in the space vehicle communication system. In order to avoid high speed optical interface single particle effect leads to abnormal interface module, design a kind of complex space environment prevention multi-channel high-speed optical interface module of single particle effect of polling monitoring and protection methods, and use a highly efficient and convenient pulse laser single particle effect corresponding laser device of simulation experiment and test. The results not only verify the single particle effect and the large current and abnormal working phenomenon of the optical interface module in the same design process under the pulse laser simulation test, but also fully verify the effectiveness of the monitoring and protection method of the multi-channel high-speed optical interface module under the single particle effect.

articleTitle: SM7 Authentication Key Distribution Algorithm for Power Field Operation Intelligent Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: For the limited storage, computing and communication resources of power field operation intelligent terminal, most of the existing key management algorithms of SM7 focus on reducing node power consumption, resulting in the limited performance of terminal security and anti-capture. In order to ensure the operation performance of job terminal nodes and improve the ability to resist physical capture attacks, a lightweight SM7 authentication key management scheme is proposed. Through the deployment of concentrator nodes, the central area of control is added to form a new double-layer grid deployment model. Based on the new structure, a two-stage key information distribution algorithm is proposed. In each stage, the security threshold of Blom matrix space is set according to the number of nodes in each sub area, which greatly improves the network connectivity and anti-capture performance of power field operation information. The simulation results show that when the proportion of captured terminals is 5.4%, and the communication link failure probability of this scheme is 62% and 67% lower than that of t-UPK and SPECC schemes.

articleTitle: Development of Lab VIEW configurable test system for temperature controller
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Comfortable temperature is an important requirement of building control. In order to optimize the intelligent building system, efficiently adjust and control the HVAC system, bring users more comfortable living space, and optimize the HVAC terminal equipment, it is necessary to communicate with the controller to obtain real-time data. However, the traditional way of using the controller is mostly adjusted on the human-machine interface (HMI), which cannot be tested uniformly for different controllers. At present, different controllers have different register addresses and the program is limited to obtaining the data of a specific controller. Different controllers cannot share a set of programs. In addition, modbus has a variety of communication modes. If the communication mode changes, the code needs to be changed and redeveloped. Most of the programming cannot make modbus universal. In order to solve the above problems, this paper focuses on several ways of communication and connection between LabVIEW and Modbus. It mainly proposes a configurable Modbus communication mechanism based on LabVIEW, the Modbus protocol is made universal. The program obtains the configuration parameters of different Modbus communication modes and the parts of different controllers through the configuration file, so as to realize the code scalability and compatibility. Therefore, the controller supporting Modbus protocol can communicate in real time as long as the configuration is modified. This method can be applied to the industrial controller supporting modbus and can effectively solve the problem of communication barriers between the configuration software LabVIEW and different controllers.

articleTitle: Wireless Queuing Scheme based on Browser/Server Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper proposes a wireless queuing scheme based on B/S architecture, which adopts software number calling and software number taking, which not only facilitates the verification of customers' real identity, but also realizes the energy-saving office requirements of “paperless”, and realizes the queue management at the window side. In this scheme, the wireless communication between hardware is realized through Bluetooth, WiFi and other technologies, which replaces the traditional wired connection, and the layout is simple and flexible. At the same time, the scheme integrates the existing equipment of the network, takes the number by pad, and uses the cabinet cleaning as a service tool to reduce the cost investment of hardware equipment. The queuing scheme adopts B/S architecture, with low cost, simple development and convenient maintenance. It is suitable for bank business halls, telecom business halls, government service center, various chain commercial bodies and other places.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Pile-Soil Interaction of Tower Platform of Transmission Line Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Through the role taken by bored piles in the group pile foundation of the transmission line engineering tower platform, the bearing capacity of the pile is analyzed. Through the numerical simulation of the finite element software ABAQUS, the soil where the group is located and contact between the piled soil are considered. The pile group foundation on one line section is selected for numerical simulation, by a load of external force, the destruction where the soil is surrounded by the group pile is analyzed. The simulation results show that the ultimate bearing capacity of the pile group can be expressed by the bearing capacity when the sedimentation is 0.05 times as long as the pile diameter, as well as the destruction and deformation process of soil is surrounded by group pile.

articleTitle: MICNet: A Hybrid Model Based on Inception Network and CNN for Automatic Modulation Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, the increasingly complex electromagnetic environment requires more accurate and rapid modulation methods. With the continuous development and application of deep learning, more and more methods and structures are proposed to solve the problem. In this letter, we propose an efficient architecture for an automatic modulation classification (AMC) based on inception network and CNN. We combine the improved inception modules with convolutional neural network (CNN) to obtain a mixed network structure (MICNet), which has fewer parameters and higher accuracy. In the experiments, MICNet reaches the overall 24-modulation classification rate of 97.54% at 28 dB SNR on the well-known DeepSig dataset. In addition, MICNet can be used for classification modulation recognition on computers with less hardware configuration.

articleTitle: Dynamics of finite energy Airy-Gaussian beam modeled by the fractional Schrodinger equation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper focuses on the dynamics of the Airy-Gaussian beam in the fractional-order Schrödinger equation with variable coefficients by using fractional Fourier algorithm, numerical simulation. The soliton splitting properties of the AIG beam can be changed by changing the distribution factor without a potential; in addition, the peak power, center of gravity, and width of the solitons of the AIG beam are changed with potential by changing the chirp and distribution factor. The prospects of AIG beams in optical operations and optical switches are confirmed through these properties.

articleTitle: Time-Varying Carrier Frequency Offset Estimation Algorithm Based on Improved Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of high precision carrier frequency offset estimation in high order modulation system, a time-varying frequency offset estimation algorithm based on improved particle filter is proposed in OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) system. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation, and the parameters that affect the performance of the particle filter are analyzed. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional methods, the proposed algorithm can achieve higher estimation accuracy and resist the effect of pulse interference.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation of two time-reversed shapes of Airy pulses in double zero dispersion medium
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper uses the split-step Fourier method to study the dynamic transmission of positive and negative Airy pulses, which are different with time, in a media with two closely spaced zero-dispersion wavelengths. The study is under the influence of self-phase modulation (SPM), intrapulse Ramen scattering (IRS) and self-steepening (SS). We study the waveform and spectrogram of those two kinds of Airy pulses in the double zero-dispersion media, as well as their three-dimensional evolution diagrams. Then, we find that in the same condition, the positive Airy pulse can gain a broader supercontinuum and negative Airy pulse can acquire a flatter one. This paper is important on how to choose suitable initial parameters of inputting pulse to optimize supercontinuum.

articleTitle: Research on Low-power Monitoring Technology of Transmission Line Galloping Based on Accelerometer Combined with Inertial Measurement Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Conductor galloping can cause serious adverse effect on transmission line operation. In order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the power system, it is necessary to carry out a monitoring and analysis method of the galloping state in an intelligent way. So far, the existing monitoring method still have some limitation such as high power consumption, high cost and low accuracy, which are difficult to meet the huge demand of comprehensive perception. In view of this, a low-power and high- accuracy transmission line galloping monitoring scheme based on acceleration sensor combined with inertial measurement unit (IMU) is put forward in this paper. Firstly, based on the acceleration sensor, the low-power edge calculation of the galloping amplitude is carried out by using the frequency domain integration method with the help of Fourier transformation algorithm. After the amplitude reaching the preset value, the IMU inside the device is automatically activated. By reading acceleration and angular velocity from IMU, the Quaternion Algorithm is adopted to realize the high-precision measurement of amplitude and trajectory through time domain integration method. Based on the multi-sensor joint algorithm, the sensor can achieve the high accuracy of the galloping characteristic parameters and the minimum power consumption. At the same time, an elliptical trajectory simulation device is designed to test the algorithm. Compared with the traditional method, all the calculation was done inside the sensor, which reduced the data scale and power consumption significantly. With the improvement in reliability, intelligence and accuracy of the sensor, this method can strongly support the daily maintenance work of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research on aggregate trust degree calculation method of power Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems, the power Internet of Things is more open and easy to connect. Therefore, it is more susceptible to multiple security threats such as identity disguised access, information theft, data tampering, etc., and there is an urgent need to study trusted access and trusted information acquisition technologies. Aiming at the problem of terminal trust in the power Internet of Things, this paper proposes a trust calculation method that aggregates direct trust and indirect trust to evaluate the trustworthiness of the terminal. The algorithm breaks through the shortcomings of traditional methods that only use fixed direct information values, uses sliding window forgetting factors to update direct trust values, and introduces indirect trust values to make up for the inaccuracy of direct trust judgments, and improves judgment accuracy through the aggregation of the two. Experimental simulations in a variety of scenarios show that the method in this paper can effectively identify the trust degree of terminal nodes in the normal state and in the presence of switch attacks, and is more accurate and faster than binomial trust management and trust evaluation based on beta distribution.

articleTitle: The novel microstrip monopulse array antenna based on comparator network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the radar tracking and positioning system, an antenna is required to accurately detect the location of the target. A new mono-pulse antenna and comparator network with a cross-shaped microstrip structure are proposed, and the microstrip mono-pulse array antenna is successfully designed and processed with this network. The antenna array consists of 4 8x6 microstrip antenna sub-arrays. The sum and difference network and the antenna array are in the same plane, so it has the advantages of compact structure, good stability, convenient processing and low cost. According to the actual measurement results, the sum and difference patterns in the horizontal and vertical directions are in good agreement with theoretical predictions, indicating that the designed antenna can improve the accuracy and stability of the radar tracking and positioning system.

articleTitle: Application of an improved oriented object detection algorithm in remote sensing images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, in the field of remote sensing image target detection, oriented target detection has received extensive attention. Traditional detectors use horizontal bounding box (HBB) to locate targets, which may cause inaccurate detection when detecting targets with arbitrary orientation angles, dense distribution and large aspect ratios. The Oriented Bounding Box (OBB) adds different rotation angles to the horizontal bounding box, which can better deal with the above problems. However, with the introduction of oriented bounding boxes in the detector, new problems have emerged, such as the increase in the number of anchor points with different scales, angles, and aspect ratios, and the imbalance of IoU matching of positive and negative anchor boxes, which leads to classification confidence and Inconsistency between positioning accuracy. In order to overcome these shortcomings while using the oriented bounding box, this paper proposes a novel oriented target detector and redesigns a matching strategy for evaluating the position of the anchor frame. By selecting a higher quality anchor frame to achieve more accurate target detection, thereby reducing the instability of the angle in the matching process. Experiments conducted on public remote sensing data sets such as HRSC2016 and UCAS-AOD show that the proposed method achieves advanced detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Efficient Management System of Construction Engineering Industry Based on ERP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: ERP is a widely used operation management system for construction enterprises. It is guided by modern enterprise operation thought and combines the actual construction of engineering projects to carry out system construction. At the same time, it provides information services for operation and management personnel. Aiming at the management problems currently faced by engineering companies, this paper has developed a set of ERP efficient management systems for the engineering construction industry. And conducting performance tests by professional testing tools, the test results show that the overall response time of the system is good. Through the deployment of the system, it is possible to effectively implement strict supervision of safety and quality, and provide scientific and effective management methods for the implementation of on-site management.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral collaborative sparse unmixing based on fusion of stacked edge-preserving filterings
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The spatial resolution of the hyperspectral image is usually low, the endmembers are uniformly mixed, and a single pixel usually contains multiple mixed endmembers. In order to extract a single endmember and its corresponding abundance coefficient in the hyperspectral images, a hyperspectral linear collaborative sparse unmixing method based on edge-preserving filtering is proposed. Firstly, the multiparameter EPF extraction and the PCA-based fusion of stacked EPFs are used to preprocess the hyperspectral image, the b,o mixed norm is used as the measure of the abundance vector to realize the collaborative sparse constraint, and the row hard threshold function is used to solve the lo optimization model. The collaborative sparse hyperspectral unmixing method can obtain the collaborative sparse abundance vector. Secondly, local reweighting constraints are added to the abundance matrix, which improves the sparsity of endmembers and abundance coefficients. Finally, the total variation regular term is added, and Alternating direction method of multipliers is used to solve the problem. In order to verify the performance of the algorithm, experiments are carried out on synthetic data and Urban data, and compared with algorithms such as CSUnLO, CSUnSAL, CSUnSAL-TV, the proposed algorithm has better unmixing accuracy than other algorithms. Experimental results show that the proposed hyperspectral unmixing model effectively improves the unmixing accuracy of hyperspectral images.

articleTitle: Dynamics of finite energy Cosh-Airy beams modeled by the fractional Schrödinger equation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In this paper, we use the Split step Fourier algorithm. The propagation property of finite energy Cosh-Airy beam in the fractional Schrodinger equation with variable coefficient is numerically studied. Its transport trajectory can be significantly changed by changing the Lévy index α of the fractional Schrodinger equation; Its shape can be significantly changed by changing the Cosh-Airy beam's initial cosh factor and truncation coefficient. These properties prove the broad application prospects of the Cosh-Airy beam in optical operations and optical switches.

articleTitle: Research on Information Intelligentization of Industrial Industry Based on ERP Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: ERP is a relatively widely used operation management system for industrial enterprises. It is guided by modern enterprise operation thinking, combined with the actual construction of engineering projects to carry out system construction, and provides information services for operation and management personnel.The emergence and development of the Internet of Things(IOT), cloud computing and mobile Internet have accelerated the process of enterprise informatization. By studying the connection of industrial enterprise informatization, ERP and intelligent decision-making assistance, this paper points out the problems and opportunities of enterprise informatization under the ERP environment, and proposes a feasible industrial industry ERP system based on cloud computing, which is expected to be realized Intelligent applications such as auxiliary decision-making on the basis of enterprise informatization provide technical support for the intelligentization of the industrial industry.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Data Management System of the Electric Power Enterprise based on the Interdisciplinary Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Aiming at the high residual rate of the traditional power enterprise integrated data management system, a comprehensive data management system for power enterprises based on cross-professional data mining is designed. In terms of hardware, metadata collector and monitoring Board are designed. At the same time, integrated power enterprise comprehensive data based on cross professional data mining, set collection time cycle, frequency, priority, increment, full amount of collection strategy, record and form report on each exploration result, establish power enterprise comprehensive data lifecycle management system, realize power enterprise comprehensive data governance function, complete system design. The experimental results show that the governance legacy rate of the designed system is significantly lower than that of the traditional system, which can solve the problem of high governance legacy rate of the traditional system.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Librarian Support Service Platform Based on 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, the development of the internet, big data and other technologies has not only brought opportunities to people’s lives, but also brought strength challenges. Integrating 5G technology into the construction of libraries to form an intelligent librarian can greatly improve work efficiency. Therefore, the design of intelligent librarian support service platform based on 5G technology is proposed. First of all, we construct the service platform by building the book resource navigation portal, setting up the user’s book custom recommendation service, establishing the smart book interactive discussion space, improving the smart librarian’s book resource management module, and creating the voice social service function of the smart librarian. Then, we test the platform through experiments to verify the relevant use effect of the platform. To ensure that it can be perceived by users, to better promote the learning and life of users, and to promote the continuous development of related industries.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Electricity Spot Market Based on Risk Matrix
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of the electricity spot market has been advancing rapidly in China. In order to ensure the stable and orderly progress of the electricity market construction, it is urgent to study the risk assessment methods of the electricity spot market. After constructing a set of risk identification index system, this paper determines the scoring standards of various risks through the formed expert group, and then establishes a risk assessment matrix, and uses the Borda method to rank the importance of each risk. In the end, the risks in the electricity spot market can be effectively identified. The research results will provide theoretical support for the design of the power spot market risk prevention system and mechanism.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of AI aided embedded OFDM receiver based on RK3399 platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technology is widely used to deal with the multipath effect. With the rise of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning method has been initially applied in the field of channel estimation and signal detection of OFDM system. This paper proposed an AI aided embedded OFDM receiver based on RK3399 platform. The channel estimation model based on CNN and BiLSTM is constructed, and PC platform and TB-RK 3399 embedded platform are used to train and deploy the proposed deep learning network model offline and online respectively. Experimental results show that, compared with the traditional LS and MMSE channel estimation methods, the proposed channel estimation method has a great improvement in estimation error and BER performance. The semi physical receiver based on TB-RK3399 achieves similar receiving performance with PC platform.

articleTitle: Electric IoTs edge computing servers deployment planning method based on the information entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: How to optimize the reasonable deployment of edge control processing node is the primary premise to improve the performance of EIoTs. Aiming at the new demand of distributed edge computing in EIoTs, this paper proposes a new method of EIoTs edge computing servers deployment based on the information entropy. By optimizing the number of edge nodes and autonomous region, the method established the EIoTs information transmission stability calculation model, calculated the EIoTs information entropy and solved the optimal deployment of EIoTs network edge computing nodes based on the maximum entropy principle. Through the improved IEEE39 node example, the optimal deployment method of edge computing nodes can effectively reduce the network congestion probability and improve the performance of EIoTs.

articleTitle: Object Detection In Power Operation Scene Based On Two-Stream Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In power production and construction, power accidents caused by the nonstandard operation of workers will not only bring economic losses but also cause personal injury. To supervise the non-standard operation of workers, this paper proposes an object detection method based on a two-stream Faster R-CNN. The main detection in the operation, whether the power workers in accordance with the requirements of electrical safety operation regulations, correctly wear a safety helmet and uniform, in order to ensure the safety of workers can get the maximum protection.
