According to the outstanding color feature of workers’ uniforms and safety helmets. In this paper, a two-stream network based on Faster R-CNN is proposed, in which the first-stream is RGB stream and the second-stream is HSV stream. The purpose of introducing HSV stream is to highlight the HSV color space features of the detected object, so that the final neural network model can be more sensitive to the HSV color space features of the detected object, so as to solve the false alarm problem when using Faster R-CNN model only. Compared with the Faster R-CNN method, the accuracy of the proposed method is improved by six percentage points.

articleTitle: Multi-load Wireless Charging System Based on Single Resonant Coupling Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The wireless charging system based on the single resonant coupling architecture can he easily developed in combination with the electromagnetic induction type, has the advantages of low cost and long distance of magnetic resonance transmission, and large power, does not need to be fully coupled with the transmitting and receiving coils, and can realize multi-load wireless charging. This paper is designed for multi-mobile device load, based on the principle of electromagnetic induction, designed a wireless charging system based on single resonant coupling architecture. The inverter circuit, resonant circuit and signal generation circuit are constructed by MATLAB. The receiving end uses Mi’s 20W wireless charging. The receiver, from the simulation and experimental aspects, studied the multi-load radio energy transmission system with resonant frequency of 127 kHz. The research results can provide reference for the research and development of wireless charging platform for mobile devices.

articleTitle: An Anti-broadband Interference Scheme in Power Wireless Private Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Based on LBT (Listen Before Talk) in 4G LAA (License Assisted Access), this paper proposes a scheme to detect and avoid broadband interference in power wireless private network. Without modifying the existing technical specifications of power wireless private network, such as LTE-G or IoT-G, it can effectively detect and avoid broadband interference through scheduling to improve the signal quality of power wireless private network using the proposed algorithm in BS (Base Station) side.

articleTitle: A Patent recommendation algorithm based on topic classification and semantic similarity
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Patent recommendation algorithms, as an important means of information push, are an important means of solving the information overload of today's massive data. However, traditional recommendation algorithms have problems such as the inability to make full use of user information, system cold start, and sparse data matrix, so this paper proposes a patented recommendation algorithm based on topic classification and semantic similarity. By introducing the Bert neural network, this algorithm extracts keywords from patent titles and abstracts, and then transforms them into word vectors. By using them, the algorithm uses the DBSCAN clustering method to construct patent subject area categories. Combining with SimNet, a text similarity framework, it becomes a holistic analysis model. Inputting patent text to be predicted into trained analysis model, then it can do patent recommendation work. Comparing with the traditional recommendation algorithm, the experiment shows that the algorithm proposed in this paper can obtain a better recommendation effect on the patent recommendation.

articleTitle: Color image retrieval based on improved quaternion convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Nowadays, when performing color image texture feature extraction, most of the color images are converted into grayscale images or the color images are processed by channels. The above-mentioned traditional processing methods will largely lose the effective information of the original image when performing color image retrieval. Aiming at the problem of effective feature description in content-based image retrieval, this paper proposes a color image retrieval method based on improved quaternion convolutional neural network. First, use the quaternion method to characterize the local texture feature LBP value and R, G, and B color information of the image, and use the quaternion discrete cosine transform (QDCT) as the theoretical basis to express the color image as a quaternion matrix form. Secondly, each component of the convolutional neural network is extended to the quaternion domain, and the quaternion matrix obtained above is directly input into the proposed neural network for training and classification. Finally, the result of image retrieval is obtained. Experiments show that this method significantly improves the performance of color image retrieval.

articleTitle: Radar signal sorting based on TOA key matching and square sine wave interpolation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Pulse repetition interval (PRI) is an important parameter to realize the de-interlacing of radar signals. With the increasing complexity of radar modulation methods and the increasing density of radar signal environment, the existing PRI sorting algorithm can no longer effectively realize radar signal sorting. For this reason, a comprehensive sorting algorithm based on time of arrival (TOA) midpoint matching and square sine wave interpolation is proposed. This method uses TOA midpoint matching to propose PRI periodic modulated radar signals, and uses square sine wave interpolation to sort PRI non-periodic modulated signals. The implementation results show that the integrated method can adapt to the complex signal environment and can effectively suppress the pulse loss.

articleTitle: Trend prediction method of economic fixed base index of power industry based on time series
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of large error in the traditional trend prediction method of economic fixed base index of power industry, a trend prediction method of economic fixed base index of power industry based on time series is designed. Firstly, wavelet transform is used to exchange the data of economic fixed base index of power industry, and the data preprocessing is completed. Then, the ARIMA model is fitted to the difference series based on the time series, and the parameters are determined according to the truncation of the autocorrelation function. On this basis, the residual sequence of ARIMA model is tested. After meeting the test conditions, the forecasting algorithm of economic fixed base index trend of power industry is deduced, and the forecasting deviation is processed to get the final forecast result of fixed base index trend. The experimental results show that the prediction error of the design prediction method is much lower than that of the experimental control group, which can solve the problem of large prediction error of traditional methods.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Approach Based on Relativistic Wasserstein Generation Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As a pre-processing technology in other speech applications, speech enhancement technology is one of the kernel technologies in the field of information science. Recent research has found that generative adversarial networks have achieved a lot of research results in the field of speech enhancement. But generative adversarial networks are more difficult to train and stabilize in its application to speech enhancement. In this paper, we proposed a speech enhancement method based on relativistic Wasserstein generative adversarial networks. The experimental results show that it provides more stable training results, speeds up the convergence of the network, and produces a better generative model to improve speech enhancement without increasing the computational effort. The model provides better performance in many methods of comparing assessment metrics.

articleTitle: Research on Signal Separation of Same Frequency Based on Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The same frequency signal separation of array antenna has very important theoretical significance and practical value, and has important value in some fields of signal processing. Due to the disadvantage that FastICA algorithm based on negative entropy is sensitive to the initial value selection, this paper improves the disadvantage of FastICA algorithm based on negative entropy, and gives the FastICA algorithm and the experimental comparison of the improved FastICA algorithm through MATLAB simulation. The simulation results show that, for the separation of mixed signals with the same frequency, The improved FastICA algorithm can achieve a better separation effect.

articleTitle: Index Method of Unstructured Data in Power System Based on Improved B+ Tree
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the continuous development of smart grid online monitoring systems, the power system has accumulated a large amount of unstructured data. These data have the characteristics of diverse formats, inconsistent rules, and difficulty in establishing data indexes. B+ tree index is currently a widely used indexing technology. The traditional B+ tree index structure can only index numeric or character data but cannot index unstructured data. Given the characteristics of a large amount of unstructured data in the power system, this article proposes a method for indexing unstructured data in the power system based on an improved B+ tree, that is, the introduction of the hierarchical index method is based on the B+ tree index Structure and construct a two-level hybrid index structure. The first layer of the two-layer hybrid index structure constructs the index of the unstructured data entity class, and the second layer constructs the index of the unstructured data knowledge graph according to the corresponding attribute value of the first layer data entity class. Experimental results show that the indexing method can meet the needs of unstructured data indexing and retrieval in power systems.

articleTitle: A new Method for Identification of In-pulse Modulation of Radar Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to resolve the problem of radar in-pulse modulation feature recognition under low signal-to-noise ratio, a new automatic recognition algorithm was proposed. Firstly, the phase difference method and short-time Fourier transform (STFT) are improved to improve the feature extraction ability of phase coded signal and frequency modulated signal respectively. Then, the hierarchical decision-making method is used to recognize the in-pulse modulation feature. The simulation results show that the algorithm has obvious classification characteristics, and the total recognition result is close to 100% when the SNR is 3dB. Moreover, the algorithm requires less computation, so it has certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on the Business Model of Recycling and Reusing Sulfur Hexafluoride Gas in Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: At present, the non-carbon dioxide greenhouse gas emissions of power grid companies mainly include hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs) and sulfur hexafluoride (SF6). HFCs mainly come from refrigeration equipment used in offices, substations, converter stations, and data centers. Among them, sulfur hexafluoride is mainly used as an insulation and arc extinguishing medium, and is used in electrical equipment such as transformers, insulated circuit breakers, and gas-insulated enclosed switchgear (GIS). This article mainly focuses on the recovery and reuse of sulfur hexafluoride, analyzes the management and control of sulfur hexafluoride gas carried out by power grid enterprises, and proposed a sustainable development model based on Internet thinking and canvas model.

articleTitle: Reasonable Range Prediction and Loss Reduction Governance Model of Line Loss in Station Area Based on GRNN
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the grid connected scale of distributed power generation, it is urgent to accurately calculate the line loss rate of the station area with distributed power generation. However, at present, there are technical bottlenecks in the acquisition and calculation accuracy of operating parameters in low-voltage active stations, so it is difficult to realize the reasonable range prediction of line loss and high loss identification. This paper fully considers the basic operation attribute of the station area and the grid connection attribute of distributed energy, and proposes a calculation method of GRNN station area line loss rate based on feature extraction. Firstly, the line loss influence factors of the station area with photovoltaic distributed power supply are extracted. Secondly, each station area cluster is trained by GRNN, and the error between the training results and the real line loss is analyzed; finally, the ability of the proposed algorithm in reasonable interval prediction and high line loss rate station area recognition is tested.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibility Predict Based on the Forth Class Key Antenna Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: At present, the electromagnetic interference problem is serious between the airborne electronic equipment increasingly. The compatibility analysis and forecasting among devices are the premise to guarantee the equipment to work normally. This paper puts forward a method to predict electromagnetic compatibility among systems using the model of forth class key antenna. This model can simulate antenna pattern better, without actual measured datas. This paper takes horn antenna as an example, and the fitting effect had been verified by simulation experiment, and we draw the conclusion through the examples: the mutual coupling value by forth class key antenna model can be used to calculate antenna coupling energy in the electromagnetic compatibility forecast between systems, the mutual coupling probability value can be used as the probability gist of electromagnetic compatibility prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of 5G Patch Antenna Array for Mobile Phone Operating in Millimeter-wave Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The millimeter-wave spectrum plays a vital part in 5G communication, e.g., the n258 band is recommended to achieve ultra-high-speed data for mobile phones. However, most current patch antennas currently used in 5G mobile devices cannot cover the entire spectrum (n258). In this study, a new type of patch antenna model for the n258 band used in mobile phones has been designed and simulated in CST. Rogers RT5880 material was used as a substrate to deliver higher working frequency and broader bandwidth. Based on the simulations, the S1-1 curve is lower than -10dB from 24.25~27.5GHz for each antenna with dimensions of 9.5 × 9.0 × 1.1(mm). Besides, the realized gain is above 6.3dB in the same band by HFSS simulations. Meanwhile, its performance would be further improved when this kind of antennas form an array. These results indicate that this antenna’s dimension and performance meet the operating requirements of 5G mobile phones. Additionally, it is proved that the antenna array has the function of enhancing gain and directivity. Furthermore, the analysis substantiates those available materials with lower dielectric constants should be developed for a substrate. These results shed light for future patch antennas designed in 5G mobile devices.

articleTitle: An improved change detection algorithm for remote sensing images
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In this paper, a weakly-supervised change detection model (Siam-DenNet) is proposed, the model requires only image-level labels for end-to-end training. The feature extraction network of this model is a pair of Siamese networks that share parameters, each branch uses the DenseNet network for feature extraction, in order to fully combine the feature of the lower and upper levels, all the feature diagrams generated by DenseBlock are cascaded. Since the pixels changed in the image are much smaller than the unchanged pixels, which leads to the problem of positive and negative samples and difficult sample imbalance, Hard negative mining method is adopted and the Focal Loss function is introduced. Finally, CRF is used to constrain the boundaries of the split object to ensure that the variation segmentation diagram is more accurate. This paper shows the segmentation and classification performance of the proposed model, and obtains advanced results on two public data sets, AICD and HRSCD.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Spectrum and the Demodulation of Narrowband Continuous Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the development of modern communication technology, we place a volume of the demand on communication quality and data signaling. Based on the narrow-band assumption, which usually means the bandwidth of signaling is less than 64kbit/s (Actually, the ‘narrow-band’ is a relative conception ,there isn’t an exact index to distinguish ‘narrow’ and ‘broad’ in digital communications. But in 2010.5.17, the World Telecommunications Day, ‘narrow-band’ is defined as ‘bandwidth less than 4M’ ), a new method of the derivation of spectrum using Second-order Taylor expansion is under our investigations. This method greatly simplifies the calculation without decreasing the accuracy. We use our new analysis to find the spectrum during modulation and (verify the error messages while reconstructing data in demodulating. After that, the spectrums of some frequently-used pulse shape is presented. A demodulator based on the discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) for MSK is discussed. We do DFT by the two harmonics produced by the self-multiplication of the signals, then compare the result of amplitude through a decision threshold. This system is both simple and stable. The Gaussian Filter Minimum Shift Keying (GMSK)is analyzed, and the advantages and drawbacks of CPM are also discussed in the end. This research has proved the validity of the CPM modulation and provided forceful support for the subsequent study. Therefore, we conclude that our analysis of the Spectrum and the Demodulation of Narrowband Continuous Phase Modulation has less errors.

articleTitle: Comparison of Air Conditioning System Forms in an Office Building in Jinan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Taking an office building in jinan as an example, the energy consumption, seasonal energy efficiency ratio and economy of the air-cooled heat pump air conditioning system, water-cooled screw combined gas boiler air conditioning system, soil source heat pump air conditioning system and variable refrigerant flow air conditioning system were studied. The results show that the soil source heat pump air conditioning system has great advantages in Jinan.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Digged Foundation Size on Uplift Stability Based on the Orthogonal Test
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the current transmission lines, the digged foundation has been widely used in engineering because of its advantages in fully exerting the undisturbed soil’s large uplift capacity and improving the resistance to uplift and overturning load-bearing capacity. In this paper, four dimensions of the foundation, including main column diameter, main column height, expanded bottom width and expanded bottom height, are selected. Through orthogonal experiments, the value of each size is changed, the uplift force is calculated, the uplift stability margin is obtained, and the sensitivity of each size to the stability of the foundation is studied. The results show that for single-circuit linear towers, the degree of influence on the uplift stability of the digged foundation is in the order of main column diameter>main column height>expanded bottom width>expanded bottom height; while for double-circuit linear towers, the order of influence is expanded bottom width>main column diameter>main column height>expanded bottom height. The uplift stability of the foundation increases linearly with the increase of the main column diameter and expanded bottom width. For the double-circuit linear tower, due to the limitation of the foundation bearing capacity, the increase in the uplift resistance is small with the increase of the expanded bottom width. In the actual project, the foundation size should be selected reasonably to ensure the safety of construction.

articleTitle: The Software Architecture Design for the Test and Evaluation Platform of Distributed Photovoltaic Comprehensive Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As an important method of regenerated energy utilization, photovoltaic power generation has been vigorously developed at home and abroad in recent years. As a kind of photovoltaic power generation, distributed photovoltaic power generation can make full use of relatively scattered sites such as residential houses, factories, and buildings for installation. Compared with centralized photovoltaic power generation, distributed photovoltaic power generation has the characteristics of flexible power generation module design, local consumption, and short investment payback period. Therefore, it has been vigorously developed in recent years. In order to meet the high quality research and development needs of distributed photovoltaic module-level power conversion devices, and achieve accurate evaluation and analysis of the technical performance index of the developed products, this paper proposes a the test and evaluation platform of distributed photovoltaic comprehensive energy efficiency and elaborates its software architecture design.

articleTitle: MCC and OCR-to-CPTU method for strength assessment in Hiep Thanh offshore wind power project
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Piezocone penetration test (CPTU) is one of the most widely used method for geotechnical investigation in offshore power projects. As a case study, direct quick shear, triaxial UU and triaxial CU tests and CPTU were carried out in Hiep Thanh offshore wind power project in south Vietnam to analyse the strength of clayey soil. articleTitle: Comparison of CRC and Convolutional Coding in BLE
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Bluetooth and Wi-Fi technology are commonly used in many areas, including smart phones, smart wearable devices, and Internet of Things (IoT). These technologies build communication bridges between any users. Bluetooth transceivers have been in the active filed of recent research since the low power consumption of Bluetooth Low energy (BLE) has proved its positions in IoT applications compared with conventional Bluetooth devices. With the development of digital communication, people have a higher requirement for their communication quality so that decreasing bit error rate is one method to meet the requirements. This paper decreases the bit error rate (BER) to the BLE standard using utilizing data redundancy provided by the Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) code and convolutional code. To decrease the bit error, firstly, Bluetooth Low Energy and its applications about IoT are introduced. Also, to get deep understanding of this technology, basic principle of communication is required. Next, two main codes suitable for BLE communication are discussed. One is Cyclic Redundancy Check code, and the other is convolutional code. In this stage, it analyzes advantage and disadvantage about two codes, and then simulates these methods on MATLAB to see how they affect the BER. At the same time, a new approach is given for reducing BER after the comparison between CRC code and convolutional codes. It is the approach that combining CRC and convolutional code is applied to BLE error correction process. This method can have an effective result on error correction, which decreases the BER. Through this method, it can potentially extend the battery life of BLE device and help increase the quality of communication.

articleTitle: Double-Layer Improved K-Means Based Electricity Industry Classification Method
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the traditional industry classification, load characteristics of users in the same industry are quite different, seriously affecting their application. Thus, this paper focuses on the commonality of user behavior and proposes a novel industry classification method based on two-layer improved k-means algorithm, which optimizes the selection of cluster number. In the upper-level clustering, daily load curve of each enterprise is firstly plotted so that the improved k-means algorithm is applied to obtain the typical daily load curve of each enterprise. In the lower-level clustering, the improved k-means algorithm is used to cluster the typical daily load curves of each enterprise to obtain new industry classification. Simulations are carried out with a dataset of a province in China and the results show that the proposed method can effectively achieve industry classification depend on similar electricity consumption behavior.

articleTitle: The Monitoring Method for Transmission Lines Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The surrounding environment of the transmission line is complicated, and large-scale construction machinery pose threats to the circuit facilities and wires. When anomaly occurs, too much time is required for the State Grid Corporation to fix it manually. To reduce the inspection burden, many methods have been presented in the past to diagnose and locate anomaly. In this paper, we propose a detection method for cranes, tower cranes, construction machinery based on the YOLOv3 model. In the aspect of feature extraction, Mobilenetv2 is used as the backbone network for feature extraction of abnormalities in transmission lines, and in the aspect of the recognition algorithm, the improved YOLOv3 algorithm is used as the head network for target detection based on the features extracted from the backbone network. Compared with the existing algorithms, this algorithm achieves a significant reduction in the amounts of parameters and calculations while ensuring the accuracy of the model. The results show that the proposed method can effectively and accurately realize the real-time detection of cranes, tower cranes and construction machinery in transmission lines.

articleTitle: Transformer fault detection method based on multi- source sensing data correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Transformer equipment plays an important role in the stable operation of power system, and for monitoring and troubleshooting the operation status of large transformer equipment, it can improve the efficiency of equipment maintenance and improve the reliability and stability of power distribution equipment operation. The amount of local and onesided information obtained by a single sensor on the state of the transformer is very limited, and each sensor receives its own quality, performance, and noise effects, the information collected is often imperfect, with great uncertainty. Multi-sensor information integrated system using multiple similar or heterogeneous sensors can obtain a large amount of information from multiple angles in full space, although the information obtained by some sensors is wrong, or there will be redundancy and contradiction between information, can side-react the operation of transformer state, if combined with other correlation sensing factors, can fully react to the operating state. Through point clustering and linear regression technology, the equipment sensing historical data is trained offline to detect the potential correlation between the sensing data. The test results prove that the transformer fault of multi-signal sensing is more persuasive and reliable under the factors of combining many other sensing signals.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Scheduling Method for Cooperative Target Tracking Based on ADP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to solve the limitations of limited sensing, communication, computing resources and energy supply in wireless sensor networks, a lot of basic research and development work have been carried out to study the optimal containment control problem of multi-agent systems with unknown disturbances. In this paper, through problem conversion, the robust containment control problem of the multi-agent system under unknown disturbances is first transformed into the optimal containment control problem of an auxiliary system, and a control method based on adaptive dynamic programming is proposed to solve the optimal containment control problem of multi-agent systems. Meanwhile, a VI algorithm for solving the optimal solution of the coupled DTHJB equation is proposed too. Then an actorcritic network is used to calculate the iterative solution by way of online learning with only data input and output. Finally, the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed distributed control design.

articleTitle: The Application of Adaptive Genetic Algorithm Based on Output Degree Coding in Production Scheduling Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Production scheduling problem is an important problem in the production process of enterprises. Its performance directly affects the production efficiency and economic benefits of enterprisesw. When dealing with complex production involving parts processing and workpiece assembly, the existing genetic algorithm, neural network algorithm, ant colony algorithm, migratory bird algorithm and other algorithms have some shortcomings, such as slow convergence, high cost, inaccurate results and so on. In view of these shortcomings, an adaptive genetic algorithm based on in out degree coding is proposed, which improves the coding mode of traditional genetic algorithm and introduces adaptive genetic algorithm. Compared with the quasi- critical path algorithm, the layer priority algorithm and the dynamic critical path algorithm, the experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is stable in the vicinity of the optimal solution in the 14th generation on average, which proves that the improved method can be used to solve the comprehensive job scheduling problem effectively and convergent quickly.

articleTitle: Grounding Fault Location Method of Distribution Network based on Regional Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The existing distribution network grounding fault location methods have the problem of unclear fault propagation process, which leads to low maximum load rate. A distribution network grounding fault location method based on regional grid is designed. According to the characteristics of zero neutral point voltage in normal operation of power grid, the types of grounding modes are identified, the transient characteristics are identified, the loop current oscillation modes of feeders are obtained, the fault propagation process is extracted by traveling wave fault location, the distance from fault point to line endpoint is calculated, the wavelet denoising model of distribution network is constructed, and the security threshold of fault area is quantified. The key fault points are located by regional grid, and the design of fault location method is realized. The experimental results show that: the average maximum load rate of the designed distribution network grounding fault location method is higher, which proves that the use value of the fault location method integrating regional grid is higher.

articleTitle: Visual SLAM algorithm based on RGB-D
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor real-time performance and low accuracy in visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), a visual SLAM algorithm based on RGB-D is designed. Firstly, it uses the improved oriented fast rotated brief (ORB) algorithm to extract feature points of RGB image; Secondly, the random sample consensus (RANSAC) method is employed for feature matching, and the iterative closest point (ICP) algorithm is applied to estimate camera pose according to the matched point pairs. In order to make localization more accurate, the closed-loop detection is added to reduce the cumulative error in localization process, and the general graph optimization(G20) is utilized to optimize the estimated camera pose graph to obtain the best global camera pose and motion trajectory; Finally, a 3D dense point cloud map is constructed. For FR1 data sets, the average root mean square error (RMSE) is 0.043m, the minimum RMSE is 0.029m, and the average image processing time per frame is 0.034s, which meets the requirements of visual SLAM.

articleTitle: Research on Spectrum Allocation Method in Cellular Mobile Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In the modern cellular mobile communication system, the spectrum becomes more and more significant. How to allocate spectrum resource has been an important research issue. In this paper, some algorithms in the system are studied, Fractional Frequency Reuse and Integer Frequency Reuse 3 are used to combine to make a new method and simulate the capacity of our method. The performance of the system in a different environment with different users are also simulated. Then the capacity of the system is analyzed when the number of users keeps a fixed value. The simulation shows that the method that combining the Fractional Frequency Reuse and Integer Frequency Reuse method will show a better performance than a single method, for example, only Integer Frequency Reuse 3. This research also finds that the number of users will be limited if a perfect capacity is required.

articleTitle: SDN controller deployment method with capacity and control link reliability constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: In order to solve the complex problem of controller deployment in large-scale Software Defined Network, this paper proposes a controller deployment method based on Graph Community Detection algorithm. The algorithm defines the node similarity based on the distance and reachability between nodes, calculates the modularity index of each network division according to the node similarity, and the division scheme with the largest modularity index is the best division result; at the same time, introduces the controller load difference, combined with the limitation of the controller capacity, to ensure the reliability of the partition result and reduce the deployment cost. Meanwhile, considering the control link reliability constraints, the optimal controller deployment location is obtained to minimize the average control latency. Simulation results show that, compared with the original Graph Community Detection-Controller Placement algorithm, k-means algorithm and Louvain Community Placement Strategy algorithm, this algorithm can effectively reduce the average control latency, balance the load of each controller in the network, and improve the reliability of the control link.

articleTitle: Pilot Aided Phase Recovery for QAM Coherent Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: We study a pilot aided phase recovery scheme for high-order quadrature-amplitude modulation (QAM) coherent optical communications. The phase of the pilots was estimated by an optimal phase estimator, which is a linear filter whose impulse response consists of a causal and an anti causal exponential sequence. And we truncated it as a finite-impulse-response (FIR) filter. The pilots are inserted into the data symbols periodically and removed at the receiving end. Since the phase of the pilots can be accurately estimated, they are used to estimate the phase of the data symbols. Simulation results have shown that the method can reduce the power penalty to 1dB level in the 64-QAM system.

articleTitle: A Research of PPM in Digital Communication : The Influence of SNR
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Automatic modulation identification and parameter estimation of digital communication signals are the key technologies in communication systems. In recent years, with the rapid development of modern communication and signal processing technology, the communication signal system and modulation style are becoming more complex and diverse. In addition, the signal transmission environment has become increasingly bad, all of these changes make the communication signal identification, and parameters estimation requirements are getting higher and higher. In this paper, we study some modulation and demodulation methods in digital communication. According to the published literature at home and abroad and our simulations, the theory of automatic modulation recognition for communication signals is increasingly rich and perfect, especially in the low SNR of modulation recognition and parameter estimation problem under the condition of more concern.

articleTitle: Business behavior identification and risk control based on BP neural networkaper
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Business risk is brought by the uncertain changes of business environment and other factors, and business risk measurement is the core of business risk management. In this big environmental risk. This paper puts forward a business risk assessment method based on BP neural network. The steps of this method include the establishment of business risk evaluation index system and FA index processing; The BP neural network model is constructed, and an example is used to train the model, and the feasibility of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on smart grid big data’s curve mean clustering algorithm for edge-cloud collaborative application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: As the demand for smart grid construction increases, advanced power applications based on edge-cloud collaboration continue to increase. Among them, there are many data-driven artificial intelligence calculations and analyses, all of which are calculated and analyzed based on electric power big data. However, for the massive electric power big data, it is impossible to obtain more internally related information only by observing the data from the surface. To a certain extent, it directly affects the upper-level advanced applications. To solve this problem, this paper studies and proposes a curve-mean clustering algorithm for load big data, which is the most widely used load data in smart grid. By analyzing the advanced measurement infrastructure, the matrix low-rank property of load big data and the calculation of singular value, the curve mean clustering of load big data is realized, and the optimal determination method of cluster number is expounded. Experiments are conducted based on actual resident user load data and compared with the classic mean shift clustering algorithm. By calculating the average distance within the cluster, the average distance between clusters and the DI index, it is verified that the proposed method clustering is more accurate and the selection of cluster number is optimal. The research plays a very good role in basic analysis for improving the big data analysis capability and data quality of smart grid.

articleTitle: A Research of Critical Technology on Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of communication technology, people have higher requirements for communication quality. The quality of communication includes speed, delay, reliability, and so on. However, improving the quality of communication, it is also necessary to consider the communication resources, namely transmission power and bandwidth. Several decades ago, people began to use multiplexing methods to achieve both, such as time division multiplexing (TDM), frequency division multiplexing (FDM), code division multiplexing (CDM), wave division multiplexing (WDM). This paper studies the principles of FDM and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM), and verifies the feasibility of FDM and OFDM application in digital communication system through simulation and waveform analysis.

articleTitle: Cognitive Radio Optimal Price Power Control Algorithm Based on Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper uses Stackelberg game theory to introduce interference between cognitive Users (CUs), and solves the power control problem of the optimal price in the cognitive radio (CR) spectrum sharing environment. Considering the cognitive radio system with multiple users and multiple relays. Firstly, the utility function of the CU is given. The CU meets the constraints of the interference power of the primary user (PU) while equalizing the interference factors such as other CUs and relays in the system. After the CU pays a certain price, the CU is allowed to use the spectrum resource of the PU. Secondly, there is a linear relationship between the transmission power p<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf> of the CU and the pricing of the PU. The optimal pricing function of the PU is converted into a function related to the transmission power of the CU, and the optimization problem of the transmission power of the CU is given. This problem is a non-concave problem. The non-concave problem is transformed into a convex problem through variable substitution, and convex optimization is used to find the optimal solution. Finally, Proposed the optimal price algorithm to maximize the goal of PU revenue.The simulation results show that compared with the traditional unified price algorithm, the PU increases the revenue by about 40%, and the CU increases the transmission rate by about 30%.

articleTitle: Variation Analysis of Atmospheric Density at 600km
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Taking a LEO satellite on orbit for nearly 16 years as an example, based on the discussion of the long-term drift of satellite orbit elements, we focused on the change of satellite orbit height, and established the correlation model of atmospheric density and orbital attenuation rate according to the influence of space environment on the atmospheric damping of LEO satellite orbit. The correlation coefficient between F10.7 parameters and atmospheric density is analyzed by the model. Finally, the data are tested by real orbit data. Validated with orbit data, the results have shown that at the height of 600km, semi major axis decrease is obviously modulated by solar activities with degradation rate of -0.12m•d-1 in high solar activity and - 11.08m•d-1 in low solar activity and -2.29m•d-1 in average. Covering three orders of magnitude, atmospheric density is ranging from 1.32×10-15 kg•m-3 to 3.32×10-13 kg•m-3 with an average of 6.85×10-14kg•m-3. F10.7 parameter is strongly related to atmospheric density with a correlation coefficient that is less than -0.85.

articleTitle: Research on Client Side Terminal Security Detection Technology for Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The customer side terminal network in the power environment has the characteristics of high interconnection, huge network scale and higher risk than the traditional Internet of things (IOT). A complete client side terminal network system has a large number of terminals. Once a terminal is broken, the damage may spread through the terminal network at a high speed, which will have a huge impact on the whole system. This paper analyzes the current situation of client terminal and terminal network security, and analyzes its security threats. First of all, the key data indicators of online security monitoring of client side terminal equipment are analyzed and studied, and the standardized data acquisition technology of data indicators is studied. Then, based on the network security monitoring indicators, using the standardized data collected by the client side terminal equipment, the illegal attack detection technology is studied to realize the fast and accurate judgment of attack mode. Finally, the network attack detection is carried out based on neural network, and the experimental results are analyzed.

articleTitle: YOLOv5_CSL_F: YOLOv5’s Loss Improvement and Attention Mechanism Application for Remote Sensing Image Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the resolution of satellite remote sensing images and aerial remote sensing images, more and more useful data and information are obtained from remote sensing images. At the same time, compared with ordinary images, remote sensing images have the characteristics of variable directions, unbalanced categories, complex backgrounds, and difficult detection of small objects. All of these make remote sensing image object detection very challenging. In this paper, based on the deep learning framework and the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm, according to the characteristics of remote sensing images, adopting Circular Smooth Label (CSL) [1] to calculate the loss of the rotating object detection bounding box and introducing the FcaNet [2] attention mechanism to design new feature fusion modules, we propose the remote sensing image object detection algorithm YOLOv5_CSL_F. We tested the algorithm model on the DOTA dataset. Compared with the detection performance of the original YOLOv5 algorithm, our algorithm improves the detection accuracy by 0.6%.

articleTitle: A Deep Q-Learning Based VNF Migration Strategy for Elastic Control in SDN/NFV Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Network functions virtualization (NFV) solves the problem of tight coupling between network functions and hardware. While the Service Function Chaining (SFC) is the basic business model and provides customized services for network functions in NFV. However, the existing network function deployment and migration mechanisms are relatively static and rigid. For example, problems such as network load imbalance, deployment nodes or virtual network function instances failing, and virtual function elastic scaling cannot be performed. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes the decision-making optimization algorithm for virtual network function migration based on deep reinforcement learning. The algorithm takes network and node resources as constraints, establishes a migration decision model including state space, behavior space, and reward mechanism, and realizes flexible adaptation of virtual network functions. In the algorithm, migration decision-making based on Deep Q Network (DQN) includes offline training and online decision-making. In the offline training stage, DQN is used to train the strategy network model. The online migration stage is based on the trained strategy network model, which uses the current network state as the model input to dynamically generate the migration strategy. Finally, the network performs the migration of virtual network functions online. This algorithm optimizes the node load and solves the problem of service interruption caused by the excessive load of a single node, failure of links, and virtual function instances in the network. Finally, we build a practical prototype system and demonstrate the performance of the proposed DQN approach. According to the network status, the prototype system realizes the on-demand dynamic migration of virtual network functions. And the experimental results verify that the proposed elastic adaptation mechanism can effectively solve the migration problems, improve the quality of service, and enhance the scalability and flexibility of the network.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Capacity of Different Frequency Channel Allocation Method in the Simulated Amusement Park
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: This paper has conducted a comparative discussion of different channel deployment schemes based on user network usage in amusement parks. We analyze the performance of different frequency reuse algorithms in terms of the average capacity. Due to the particularity of the Internet used by tourists in the amusement park area, we have adopted FFR for it. The analytical model uses six different algorithms in the outer area of FFR (Fractional Frequency Reuse). They are IFRN (Integer Frequency Reuse), SWF (Simultaneous Water-Filling), tx-ITL (Transmit Interference Temperature Limit), and FLG (Forward-Looking Game). Considering the simplicity and just a few users in the inner part, we just apply IFR1 to the inner area of the network. The analyzation keeps all parameters the same such as SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio), simulation number, and cell number, except the number of users and the number of channels. The modeling key of this approach is to optimal tuning the number of users corresponding to a specific channel number and switch the positions of the two to adjust again. The results of these two opposite test methods finally mutually verify the correctness of each other.

articleTitle: Development of multi gas sensor in distribution room based on MEMS and advanced spectrum technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: There are some disadvantages of traditional gas sensor used in power distribution room, such as low integration, high power consumption, low life and information barrier. Thus, STM32L151RDT6 as the main control chip of a multi gas sensor is designed. The gas detection modules of the sensor are encapsulated in MEMS, to monitor multi-group gases – O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) simultaneously by using the optical detection technology and the electrochemical technology based on screen printing. To realize the data transmission and communication between the sensor and the monitoring center, the wireless transmission mode based on ZigBee technology and 485 wired transmission technology are used. In addition, the internet of things technology and multi data fusion technology are introduced to realize the interconnection between sensors. Based on the artificial intelligence algorithm, the state anomaly intelligent prediction model is established to carry out state early warning for the distribution room. After the multifunctional gas sensor performance tested, results show that the accuracy with <3% FS for the designed KIS-MS630A gas sensor. With the advantages of high detection accuracy, reliable data and stable operation, it is of great significance to realize the intelligent identification, monitoring and management of the operation state of the distribution room.

articleTitle: Structure of Named Data Networks and Security Issues
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Since the Internet has insufficient addresses to support Internet of Thing, Named Data Networking (NDN) is an eminent realization of the vision of Information-Centric Networking to address the challenges. The NDN architecture utilizes location-independent data retrieval and name-based routing. Among multitudinous features, the NDN integrates security mechanisms and focuses on protecting the content. The characteristics of the NDN attract new network attacks such as Interest Flooding Attacks (IFAs). In this paper, the structure and operations of the NDN have been introduced. The security issues of the NDN have been discussed with a survey of various IFAs and their countermeasures. The survey includes a detailed comparative study of the commonly proposed solutions against IFAs. Finally, we offer an analysis of the future research directions regarding IFAs in this paper.

articleTitle: The progress of the double-tail dynamic comparators and an improvement design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Analog-to-digital converter (ADC) is a converter that converts continuous signals in analog domain into discrete signals in digital domain, which plays an indispensable role in the development of integrated circuits. The comparator is the most important component in the ADC. The paper mainly analyses the development of high-speed, low-power, low-noise dynamic comparators and introduces an innovative comparator subsequently. Based on the demonstration of the traditional two-stage double-tail comparator, the regeneration speed of the latch stage is increased by adding two control transistors, i.e., achieves low power consumption and low delay. By transforming latch-level transistors into separated gate-biasing cross-coupled transistors, the transistors are biased in the strong inversion region, achieving the advantage of realizing high-speed comparison. In addition, this article also introduces two technologies for replacing transistors with tail capacitors, and an innovative edge-pursuit comparator (EPC) technology. These results shed light for the performance can be enhanced by adding transistors and replacing tail transistors with tail capacitors. It can also reduce delay and power consumption through innovative loop structure.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Model of Urban Rail Transit Flow Limit based on Constrained Punishment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the popularization of rail transit, the number of people who choose rail transit as a travel mode has increased, resulting in the long-term gathering of passengers at some hubs and insufficient capacity at stations. These increase the duration of passengers and have a more significant impact on the carrying capacity of urban rail transit. In order to find a reasonable number of people flow limit, and at the same time meet the urban rail carrying capacity and maximize passenger demand. Based on the AFC data of Beijing commuter lines, this paper puts forward a current limiting model of urban rail transit. Firstly, based on the AFC data, the influence of passenger demand and OD structure in the station can be described more accurately after the passenger route is identified. At the same time, compared with the previous peak data, the model can have better redundancy in the face of changes in passenger demand. Using the multi-objective optimization idea, fully consider the carrying capacity of urban rail transit and personalized passenger demand two factors. Finally, taking the single line of urban rail transit as an example, the objective function is established. On the basis of considering the dynamic change of passenger flow, the optimization of the urban rail transit transportation system and the maximization of passenger flow demand are realized.

articleTitle: An Efficient Group Secret Key Generation Scheme for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The Internet of Things technology is one of the important directions of Smart Grid research, involving many wireless sensors and communication facilities, and has high requirements for security. The physical layer security technology can effectively solve the security problems under wireless communication. As the most common application scenario of wireless communication is multi-node wireless network communication, group secret key (GSK) based on physical layer security and information theory security is gradually attracting investigator’s interest. In this paper, a novel physical layer GSK generation scheme based on code-domain exchange of channel information in mesh network is proposed. Instead of traditional side-information exchange in symbol-domain, error-correcting code is applied to finish information exchange and reconciliation simultaneously in code-domain. Each node processes the known channel bit sequence and then encodes it to generate a check sequence. After broadcasting the check bit sequence to other nodes, each node decodes the received check bit sequences to obtained the unknown channel information. The simulation results show that the scheme can effectively reduce the times of information exchanges while keeping a good performance including low bit error rate and low block error rate.

articleTitle: Rotor Speed Recovery Design Based on Frequency Increment Estimation Method for Inertial Frequency Modulation Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: The large-scale access of wind power and photovoltaic leads to the problem of frequency stability of the system, and at the end of inertia frequency modulation of variable speed wind turbines, the secondary frequency drop may occur. In order to solve this problem, a design of rotor speed recovery based on frequency increment estimation for inertial frequency modulation wind turbine is proposed. This paper analyzes the parameter change, power flow and energy flow process based on the equal area criterion, puts forward the energy conservation principle in the inertia frequency modulation process of variable speed wind turbine. According to the concept of frequency increment estimation, a simple estimation method is proposed. Then based on this method, a rotor speed recovery design with the inverse tangent function is proposed to recover the rotor speed during frequency recovery process. The simulation results show that this design can effectively suppress the secondary frequency drop of the system, maintain the stability of rotor speed and restore the operation to the maximum power point before the failure after the end of the frequency modulation, results also show that this design can smooth the output of conventional wind turbine and suppress the system frequency oscillation.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal Motif Discovery with Variable-size Sliding Windows
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Motif discovery in spatial-temporal data is very important to the comprehension of some specific phenomena in areas such as weather prediction, wind generation, and image recognition. Most motif discovery methods are generally based on support and similarity. Among them, similarity-based Matrix Profile has been adopted in domains recently. However, it generally requires defining motif length in advance, which greatly harms its applicable scenarios. Moreover, unequal lengths of subsequences can be regarded as an informative feature for mining. In this paper, we propose a Sliding Window-based Motif Discovery algorithm (SWMD), which adopts a variable-size sliding window to accurately locate motifs by detecting targets in the generated distance matrix. To achieve higher efficiency, a novel pruning strategy is proposed, where its optimal parameters are achieved through a sensitivity test. Since the proposed algorithm is fit in processing multiple dimensional data, we apply it to discover motifs from a typical and natural spatial-temporal dataset, i.e., flood. Comparative studies with three methods show that the proposed algorithm could find more meaningful motifs within an acceptable time expense.

articleTitle: Research on Instrument Position Detection Method Based on YOLOV4
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the advent of the era of Industry 4.0, more and more industrial production sites have introduced information technology and intelligent technology. Identification of indicator number in pointer instrument is one of the important applications of intelligent industry, and the instrument positioning is the first premise to realize the indicator number reading of pointer instrument. Accurate position detection in the image can provide a solid foundation for the correct reading of indicator number. This chapter focuses on the research of instrument position detection methods. Firstly, the basic theory of target detection technology is summarized. Secondly, the YOLOV4 target detection technology is introduced, and the improvement is proposed based on specific industrial scenarios. Finally, a simulation experiment is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the improved method proposed in this chapter.

articleTitle: Overview of 5G and Satellite Hybrid Network Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: With the continuous development of the fifth generation of mobile communication (5G), the integration of satellite communication network and 5G network has gradually attracted extensive attention in the industry. Satellite communication network are analyzed in this paper and the fusion of 5G network relations, according to the typical 5G with satellite network architecture, from the transmission technology, edge beam coverage, frequency spectrum resource, computing and block chain technology aspects analyzes the way of satellite communications and 5G network integration, combed the satellite network and the challenge for the 5G fusion, and converged network development direction is prospected.

articleTitle: Transformer Bushing Insulation Defect Detection Method Based on 3D Surface Map
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Wireless Communications and Smart Grid (ICWCSG)
abstract: Current transformer bushing insulation defect detection obtains detection results by measuring a single amount of change, which is susceptible to interference from signal acquisition during detection and leads to inaccurate detection range. To this end, a three-dimensional surface map-based method for transformer bushing insulation defect detection is investigated. The Bessel function is used to represent the potential fields of the inner and outer insulation of the bushing, so as to calculate the bushing dielectric loss according to the relative method. Based on the establishment of the bushing coupling non-uniform parameter model, the three-dimensional surfaces of defect types, locations and bushing parameters are plotted to achieve accurate detection of bushing insulation defects. The experimental data show that the detection error of the studied method is reduced compared to the average detection time of only 2.1s, which is feasible and better for practical application.
